articles.title: Scientists Find Dinosaur Blood That Survived 115 Million Years
articles.summary: Scientists found chemical traces of blood inside 115-million-year-old dinosaur bones, showing that delicate molecules can survive far longer than once believed.

articles.title: Permafrost Is Thawing From the Inside Out in Canada's North
articles.summary: In Canada's Mackenzie Valley, permafrost is thawing from below and triggering a new kind of landslide that carries still-frozen ground hundreds of meters.

articles.title: Ultrasound Lets Scientists Check 'Pregnant' Coral Without Harming It
articles.summary: Scientists used a medical ultrasound machine to spot eggs inside living coral, a first that lets conservationists check coral health without cutting it open.
